question_text: Make five sentences using parts of sentences from each column of the table below :
stimulus: (a) Physical fitness is physical exercise regularly. (b) Physical exercise take a precondition to lead a healthy life. (c) People of all ages should take essential for achieving physical fitness. (d) Many changes a balanced diet. (e) Beside physical exercise, everybody place inside body due to physical exercise.
guide_solution: (a) Physical fitness is a precondition to lead a healthy life. (b) Physical exercise is essential for achieving physical fitness.
